prompt: Describe checks only; do not dispatch or write files. A valid router decision specifies exact model and effort. Compare three cases: the actual dispatch omitted effort; runtime metadata reports a documented equivalent model alias; runtime metadata reports a materially different executed configuration. Explain compliance, recovery, and dependent work.
assertions: Missing effort makes dispatch noncompliant; do not call it router-selected.
Cancel mismatched submission if safe and supported, otherwise disclose before reliance; at most one corrected redispatch.
Documented equivalent alias is not noncompliance.
A material runtime override is a routing failure and pauses affected dependent work.
